gloss: various kinds; all sorts; each type

definitions.gloss: various kinds, all sorts, each type
definitions.explanation: Refers to a variety of different kinds or types. Used as a modifier before nouns to mean 'various' or 'of all kinds.'

examples.japanese: {各種|かくしゅ}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧。
{各種|かくしゅ}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}しています→提供する：21736_teikyousuru⟧。
examples.english: We offer various types of services.

examples.japanese: {各種|かくしゅ}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{比較|ひかく}→比較：03576_hikaku⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}った→合う：10466_au⟧⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}した→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I looked for a plan that suited me on a comparison site for various types of insurance.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各種|かくしゅ}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧ (various procedures)
- {各種|かくしゅ}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧ (various services)
- {各種|かくしゅ}⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧ (various types of insurance)
- {各種|かくしゅ}⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧ (various organizations)
- {各種|かくしゅ}⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧ (various qualifications)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{各種|かくしゅ} is more formal than ⟦{色々|いろいろ}→色々：02352_iroiro⟧な (various) and emphasizes that each separate type is included. It appears frequently in business, administrative, and official contexts. ⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な is another synonym but is more general and literary. {各種|かくしゅ} directly modifies nouns without ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or な.
